title: Style the current element
summary: The & sign repeats the parent selector. It helps add a state to the same element rather than choosing one of its children.
introduction: The & sign repeats the parent selector. It helps add a state to the same element rather than choosing one of its children. Your task: Choose a new outline colour that is easy to see.
learningObjectives: Choose a new outline colour that is easy to see.
Explain the example for style the current element

blocks.text: The & sign repeats the parent selector. It helps add a state to the same element rather than choosing one of its children.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
Read the code step by step

items: `:focus-visible` selects a control when the browser decides its focus should be shown, commonly during keyboard use.
`outline` draws a visible line around the control. In a value such as `3px solid navy`, the parts mean thickness, line style and colour.

blocks.text: The CSS contains .button:hover and .button:focus-visible rules for the button itself.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A hover style is not enough for keyboard users. Keep a visible focus style too.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Choose a new outline colour that is easy to see.
